turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma speaking. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Rohan from the Reserve Bank auditing wing. I am calling regarding a pending KYC update for your savings account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: KYC? But I gave all my documents to the branch last year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That was for the old portal sir, but the new RBI guidelines require a digital refresh or your account will be blocked by tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Blocked tonight? That is very sudden, I have some payments to make.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand your worry sir, that is why I am helping you. We just need to verify your identity to keep the account active.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, tell me what I need to do then.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: First, please tell me your sixteen digit debit card number and the expiry date for the system check.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I have the card here, but is it safe to tell this over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I can see your account balance is twenty five thousand rupees, if it gets blocked you will have to visit the branch and pay a fine.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I don't want any fine. It is 4521...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, now I am sending a verification code to your mobile, please read that OTP to me immediately.
